directory_prefix.description: The directory prefix where all files and subdirectories will be saved to.

wait_seconds.description: Wait the specified number of seconds between the retrievals.

random_wait.description: Causes the time between requests to vary between 0.5 and 1.5 wait seconds.

user_agent.description: Identify as this agent-string to the HTTP server.

http_proxy.description: Set the URL of the HTTP proxy.

https_proxy.description: Set the URL of the HTTPS proxy.

no_proxy.description: Do not use proxies, even if environment variables are defined.

http2_stream_window.description: Set max. number of parallel streams per HTTP/2 connection.

compression_types.description: Set Accept-Encoding header. Items: identity, gzip, deflate, xz, lzma, br, bzip2, zstd, lzip.

no_parent.description: Do not ever ascend to the parent directory when retrieving recursively.

follow_sitemaps.description: Parsing the sitemaps from robots.txt and follow the links.

xattr_enabled.description: Saves documents metadata as user POSIX Extended Attributes.

tls_protocol.description: Choose the secure protocol to be used (e.g., TLSv1_2, TLSv1_3, PFS).

check_certificate.description: Check the server certificate against the available certificate authorities.

output_log_file.description: Log all messages to this file.

page_requisites.description: Download all files necessary to properly display a given HTML page.

convert_links.description: Convert links in the document to make them suitable for local viewing.

adjust_extension.description: Append .html suffix to files of type application/xhtml+xml or text/html.

force_directories.description: Create a hierarchy of directories, even if one would not have been created otherwise.

exclude_directories.description: Specify a comma-separated list of directories to exclude from download.

accept_suffixes.description: Specify a comma-separated list of file name suffixes or patterns to accept.

reject_suffixes.description: Specify a comma-separated list of file name suffixes or patterns to reject.

ca_certificate_file.description: CA certificate bundle file for SSL verification.

client_certificate_file.description: Client certificate file for mutual TLS.

client_key_file.description: Client private key file for mutual TLS.

dns_cache_preload_file.description: Load a list of IP / Name tuples into the DNS cache.

retry_conn_refused.description: Consider 'connection refused' a transient error and try again.

tcp_fast_open.description: Enable support for TCP Fast Open (TFO).

fsync_policy.description: Enables disk syncing after each write.

max_threads.description: Specifies the maximum number of concurrent download threads for a resource.

chunk_size.description: Download large files in multithreaded chunks (bytes). 0 means off.

default_http_port.description: Set the default port for HTTP URLs.

default_https_port.description: Set the default port for HTTPS URLs.

spider_mode.description: Behave as a Web spider, checking that pages are there without downloading.

network_timeout.description: Set the network timeout in seconds.

dns_timeout.description: Set the DNS lookup timeout in seconds.

connect_timeout.description: Set the connect timeout in seconds.

read_timeout.description: Set the read (and write) timeout in seconds.

wait_retry_max.description: Max seconds for linear backoff between retries.

backup_converted.description: Back up the original version of a converted file with a .orig suffix.

mirror_mode.description: Turn on options suitable for mirroring (recursive, timestamping, infinite depth).

delete_after.description: Delete every single file downloaded after having done so.

referer_url.description: Include Referer header in HTTP request.

load_cookies_file.description: Load cookies from file before the first HTTP(S) retrieval.

save_cookies_file.description: Save cookies to file before exiting.

keep_session_cookies.description: Causes --save-cookies to also save session cookies.

hsts_file_path.description: Override the HSTS database file path.

hpkp_file_path.description: Override the HPKP database file path.

tls_session_file_path.description: Override the TLS Session database file path.

ocsp_file_path.description: Override the OCSP database file path.

follow_tags.description: Comma-separated list of HTML tag/attribute pairs to follow.

ignore_tags.description: Comma-separated list of HTML tags to ignore.

include_directories.description: Comma-separated list of directories to follow in recursive download.

exclude_domains.description: Comma-separated list of domains not to follow.

follow_domains.description: Comma-separated list of domains to follow.

span_hosts.description: Enable spanning across hosts when doing recursive retrieving.

protocol_directories.description: Use the protocol name as a directory component of local file names.

cut_dirs_count.description: Ignore a number of directory components in recursive mode.

restrict_file_names_mode.description: Change which characters in remote URLs must be escaped (unix, windows, etc.).

trust_server_names.description: On a redirect, use the last component of the redirection URL as the local file name.

auth_no_challenge.description: Send Basic HTTP authentication information for all requests.

content_on_error.description: Do not skip the content when the server responds with an HTTP error status.

save_content_on_codes.description: Comma-separated list of HTTP status codes to save content for (e.g., '*,!404').

download_attr_mode.description: How to handle the download HTML5 attribute (strippath, usepath).

not check_certificate.description: Boolean value representing the negation of check_certificate for Jinja logic if needed, though template handles it.

client_certificate_type.description: Specify the type of the client certificate (PEM, DER).

client_key_type.description: Specify the type of the private key (PEM, DER).

ca_directory.description: Specifies directory containing CA certificates in PEM format.

random_file.description: Use file as the source of random data for seeding the PRNG.

egd_file.description: Use file as the EGD socket.

hsts_preload.description: Enable loading of a HSTS Preload List.

hsts_preload_file.description: Load HSTS data from this file in DAFSA format.

ocsp_date.description: Check if OCSP response is too old.

ocsp_nonce.description: Allow nonce checking when verifying OCSP response.

https_only.description: When in recursive mode, only HTTPS links are followed.

http2_only.description: Resist on using HTTP/2 and error if a server doesn't accept it.

https_enforce_mode.description: How to deal with URLs that are not explicitly HTTPS (none, soft, hard).

convert_file_only.description: Convert only the filename part of the URLs.

strict_comments.description: Terminate comments at the first occurrence of -->.

accept_regex.description: Specify a regular expression to accept file names.

reject_regex.description: Specify a regular expression to reject file names.

regex_type.description: Specify the regular expression type (posix, pcre).

filter_urls.description: Apply the accept and reject filters on the URL before starting a download.

ignore_case.description: Ignore case when matching files and directories.

filter_mime_types.description: Specify a comma-separated list of MIME types that will be downloaded.

list_plugins.description: Print a list of all available plugins and exit.

plugin_name.description: Load a plugin with a given name.

plugin_help.description: Print the help messages from all loaded plugins.

plugin_opt.description: Set a plugin specific command line option.

ask_password.description: Prompt for a password on the command line.

askpass_command.description: Prompt for a user and password using the specified command.

local_encoding.description: Force Wget2 to use encoding as the default system encoding.

remote_encoding.description: Force Wget2 to use encoding as the default remote server encoding.

input_encoding.description: Use the specified encoding for the URLs read from --input-file.

unlink.description: Force Wget2 to unlink file instead of clobbering existing file.

cut_url_get_vars.description: Remove HTTP GET Variables from URLs.

cut_file_get_vars.description: Remove HTTP GET Variables from filenames.

default_page_name.description: Use name as the default file name when it isn't known.

http_proxy_user.description: Specify the user for HTTP proxy authentication.

http_proxy_password.description: Specify the password for HTTP proxy authentication.

proxy_user.description: Specify the username for proxy authentication (deprecated, use http_proxy_user).

proxy_password.description: Specify the password for proxy authentication (deprecated, use http_proxy_password).

no_http_keep_alive.description: Turn off the 'keep-alive' feature for HTTP(S) downloads.

cookie_suffixes_file.description: Load the public suffixes used for cookie checking from the given file.

verify_save_failed.description: Instructs Wget2 to keep files that don't pass PGP signature validation.

metalink_enabled.description: Follow/process metalink URLs without saving them.

hyperlink.description: Hyperlink names of downloaded files so that they can opened from the terminal.

force_progress.description: Force Wget2 to display the progress bar in any verbosity.

progress_type.description: Select the type of the progress indicator (none, bar).

force_input_html.description: When input is read from a file, force it to be treated as an HTML file.

force_input_css.description: Read and parse the input file as CSS.

force_input_sitemap.description: Read and parse the input file as sitemap XML.

force_input_atom.description: Read and parse the input file as Atom Feed XML.

force_input_rss.description: Read and parse the input file as RSS Feed XML.

force_input_metalink.description: Read and parse the input file as Metalink.

base_url.description: Resolves relative links using URL as the point of reference.

input_file.description: Read URLs from a local or external file.

output_document.description: All documents will be concatenated together and written to file.

start_position.description: Start downloading at zero-based position OFFSET.

backup_count.description: Before (over)writing a file, back up an existing file.

no_clobber.description: If a file is downloaded more than once, refuse to download newer copies.

no_if_modified_since.description: Do not send If-Modified-Since header in -N mode.

no_use_server_timestamps.description: Don't set the local file's timestamp by the one on the server.

server_response.description: Print the response headers sent by HTTP servers.

save_headers.description: Save the headers sent by the HTTP server to the file.

http_method.description: For the purpose of RESTful scripting, send this HTTP Method.

post_data.description: Use POST as the method for all HTTP requests and send the specified data.

post_data_file.description: Use POST as the method and send the contents of file.

body_data.description: Send additional data to the server along with the Method specified.

body_data_file.description: Send the contents of file to the server along with the Method specified.

http_headers.description: Send these header-lines along with the rest of the headers in each HTTP request.

max_redirects.description: Specifies the maximum number of redirections to follow.

signature_extensions.description: Specify the file extensions for signature files, without the leading dot.

gnupg_homedir.description: Specifies the gnupg home directory to use when verifying PGP signatures.

local_db_enabled.description: Enables reading/writing to local database files (HSTS, HPKP, etc.).
